title: Cafe Rise 139 | Royal Flush | Infinity Rising
description:
00:00 Beverage Choices
02:41 Land Grab
05:37 Shoes Marketplace Sale
08:28 Nodes
13:09 0.3.2 Release
30:09 Community Questions
37:09 Leak!

In this episode, Rob and Josh kick things off with a look at the upcoming Land Grab and the ongoing testing phase, laying out how these milestones shape the road ahead. They also share updates on the Nodes infrastructure and explain their role in the ecosystem. Followed by a walk through the highlights of the 0.3.2 release—before ending with a shiny surprise: a Golden Leak you won’t want to miss.

Linktree: https://linktr.ee/infinityrisinggame

infinityrisinggame is a cutting edge MMO RPG, set in a world where humanity has ascended from the earth's surface and created a breathtaking New World in the sky.

This Fantastical realm is a system of floating islands carved from the land we once called home now encased in a radically advanced dome-shaped structures suspended high above the clouds. Each one is a futuristic Marvel with its own unique environment identity and thriving communities it's within these domes. 

The Epic Journey begins here, as players take control of their own personal Avatar. Which gives them the freedom to choose their Destiny, be immersed in vast Landscapes. explore vibrant settlements and engage in a myriad of activities such as crafting, commerce, combat, racing, and more.

Welcome to a world where the sky is no longer the limit!
